# costfluent_tag_policy (Resource)

Manages a workspace's tag policy: the tag keys its cost must carry. A workspace has one policy, replaced whole on every apply, so manage it from one resource only; creating this resource replaces any policy the workspace already has, and destroying it clears the rules. Costfluent measures cost against the policy and changes nothing in the cloud. Needs a token with `manageTags` and `viewTags` on the workspace.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "costfluent_workspace" "production" {
  name     = "Production"
  currency = "USD"
}

# The tag keys the production workspace's cost must carry. Rules add up: a cost row must carry the
# required keys of every rule that applies to it. Costfluent measures cost against the policy and
# changes nothing in the cloud. A workspace has one policy, so manage it from one resource only.
resource "costfluent_tag_policy" "production" {
  workspace_id = costfluent_workspace.production.id

  # Every provider and every account.
  rule {
    required_keys = ["team"]
  }

  # Two AWS accounts also need an environment and a cost center.
  rule {
    provider      = "aws"
    account_ids   = ["123456789012", "210987654321"]
    required_keys = ["env", "cost-center"]
  }
}

# Saving the first rules creates a cost report of the cost missing a required key, by account.
output "untagged_cost_report_id" {
  value = costfluent_tag_policy.production.report_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `rule` (Block List) Rules in order. Rules add up: a cost row must carry the required keys of every rule that applies to it. At most 20; with none, the workspace has no policy. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--rule))
- `workspace_id` (String) Workspace ID. When omitted, the provider's default workspace at creation is recorded and kept, so a later change to the provider's default does not move it.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The workspace ID: a workspace has one tag policy.
- `report_id` (String) The cost report listing cost that misses a required key, by account. Saving the first rules creates it; it is kept when the rules are cleared, and reused when rules are saved again. Null before the first rules, or once the report is deleted, until the next save creates another.

<a id="nestedblock--rule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rule`

Required:

- `required_keys` (List of String) The tag keys a cost row the rule applies to must carry with a value, compared case-sensitively. One to 20, each named once.

Optional:

- `account_ids` (List of String) Account IDs as the provider writes them; the rule applies to cost of these accounts. Unset or empty, it applies to every account. At most 50, each named once.
- `provider` (String) The provider whose cost the rule applies to (e.g., aws, azure, gcp), as the Public API spells it. Unset, the rule applies to every provider.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# An import reads a rule without accounts with account_ids unset, so a rule written with
# account_ids = [] plans one in-place update after the import that changes nothing in the policy.

# The import ID is the workspace ID: a workspace has one tag policy.
terraform import costfluent_tag_policy.production wsp_0000000000000000000001
```
